hops sql --no-verify --catalog hudi --schema mlpab6cece9_featurestore "SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct account_id) a, max(event_time) mx FROM feature_history_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpab6cece9_featurestore "SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct account_id) a, max(event_time) mx FROM feature_history_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab6cece9_featurestore "SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct account_id) a, max(event_time) mx FROM feature_history_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -8

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab6cece9_featurestore --json --limit 0 "WITH valid AS (SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) rn FROM feature_history_1 WHERE event_time <= 1773507600000) SELECT account_id, round(1.0/(1.0+exp(-(0.3855*f1 + 0.5238*f2 + (-0.5888)*f3 + 0.066))), 6) AS score FROM valid WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY account_id" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "^$" | tail -+1 > .tmp_scores.json; wc -l .tmp_scores.json; head -20 .tmp_scores.json; echo "..."; grep -c account_id .tmp_scores.json

mkdir -p .tmp; hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab6cece9_featurestore --json --limit 0 "WITH valid AS (SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) rn FROM feature_history_1 WHERE event_time <= 1773507600000) SELECT account_id, round(1.0/(1.0+exp(-(0.3855*f1 + 0.5238*f2 + (-0.5888)*f3 + 0.066))), 6) AS score FROM valid WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY account_id" 2>.tmp/err.log 1>.tmp/scores_raw.json; echo "exit=$?"; tail -5 .tmp/err.log; echo "---grepcount---"; grep -c '"account_id"' .tmp/scores_raw.json
tool_input.description: Run scoring SQL, save JSON output

tool_input.command: head -5 .tmp/scores_raw.json; echo "..."; tail -3 .tmp/scores_raw.json

cp .tmp/scores_raw.json .tmp/scores.json
hops fg create scores4b027f --version 1 \
  --primary-key account_id \
  --online \
  --features "account_id:string:Account id,score:double:Sigmoid score as of T" \
  --description "Batch scores valid as of T=1773507600000" \
  --if-exists get --json 2>.tmp/cerr.log 1>.tmp/create.json; echo "exit=$?"; tail -3 .tmp/cerr.log; grep -i online .tmp/create.json | head
hops fg insert scores4b027f --version 1 --file .tmp/scores.json --json 2>.tmp/ierr.log 1>.tmp/insert.json; echo "exit=$?"; tail -4 .tmp/ierr.log; cat .tmp/insert.json | grep -v INFO

hops fg preview scores4b027f --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -v INFO | head -12; echo "===INFO==="; hops fg info scores4b027f --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'online|name|version|primary' | head
